brainlife.desc: T1-weighted anatomical MRI volume (NIfTI), the usual reference image for registration and cortical reconstruction.
brainlife.name: neuro/anat/t1w

original.desc: T1-weighted magnetic resonance data (MRI), saved in NIfTI-1 format.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Reference anatomy for registration, brain extraction, tissue segmentation and FreeSurfer reconstruction. Anatomical constraint for tractography (5TT) and ROI or atlas warping.

**Not for:** Apps expecting acpc_aligned or brain_extracted inputs when the object lacks those tags. Public sharing before defacing (check the defaced tag).

**BIDS:** anat/T1w (equivalent)

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 180 Apps, output of 59 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.anat.t1w.json

identifying_risks: Face is recognisable in non-defaced images
JSON metadata may hold acquisition dates, institution or device serials
sharing_cautions: Deface before sharing outside a controlled project
